title: matter: Bluetooth Transport Protocol dissector
description:
The dissector code is based on Matter Specification Version 1.3, section
4.18. Bluetooth Transport Protocol (BTP)

https://csa-iot.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/Matter-1.3-Core-Specification.pdf

notes.body:
@nicolas17, as an original author of Matter dissector, could you look at this merge request?

I'm still not sure what should be the name of the dissector. On one hand it's part of Matter, on the other hand it's part of Bluetooth ATT...

~~Also, I can see that the CI check has failed because I've attached "matter-btp" to "matter" protocol, which violates some checks. What would be the best approach here?~~

![Screenshot_from_2024-06-21_15-28-32](/uploads/43950e269025f4a195cd86824135a93f/Screenshot_from_2024-06-21_15-28-32.png)
I think, you need also to make your repo public...

Need to fix this

```
Commit validation failure:
  ~~~
  Checking commit: 23cefee3 matter: Bluetooth Transport Protocol dissector
ERROR: Please edit your merge request and make sure the setting
    ✅ Allow commits from members who can merge to the target branch
is checked so that maintainers can rebase your change and make minor edits.
  ~~~
```

It seems like BTP is a different protocol at a different abstraction layer, encapsulating Matter messages ("Matter in BTP in BTLE" vs "Matter in UDP in IP"). It certainly shouldn't use `proto_matter`. Maybe it should even be in a separate *file*? We could add a packet-matter.h to expose the needed functions to dissect Matter messages, but currently it doesn't seem to even need that, as the BTP payload in your dissector is just `FT_BYTES`.

Can you provide a sample capture? I don't have an easy way to generate BTP traffic nor to capture it.

> It seems like BTP is a different protocol at a different abstraction layer

Yes, that's basically it. BTP, and in that case Matter BTP, is a detailed dissector for Bluetooth ATT profile. My original thought was to add something like "btatt-btp-matter" or something... But I'm really not sure what name would be appropriate.

> We could add a packet-matter.h to expose the needed functions to dissect Matter messages

No, it's not required. Matter BTP messages are not related to Matter IPv6 traffic. Matter BLE traffic is used for commissioning process (i.e. certificates exchange, W-Fi credentials exchange). All this is in the BTP payload. However, for now, only BTP protocol itself is dissected.

> Can you provide a sample capture?

[matter-btp.dump](/uploads/6f84dfe9da05c369075224799b80ad5d/matter-btp.dump)
